title: Pure Celtic Guard
summary: Celtic Guard is Yugi Muto's EARTH Warrior swarm archetype centered around Celtic Guard of Noble Arms, which attacks with 2100 ATK while your hand is empty, draws cards equal to the Celtic Guards you control on hit, and summons Celtic Guards from hand. Supported by Unexpected Dai and Heritage of the Chalice, the deck floods the field for Rank 4 Warrior Xyz plays and massive battle draw phases.

allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons the original Celtic Guardian directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches any Level 4 Celtic Guard monster from the Deck.
allow.Heritage of the Chalice: Searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms from the Deck or recovers it from the GY.
allow.Morgan, the Enchantress of Avalon: Level 3 handtrap that negates any card or effect by destroying an Equip Spell while you control a 'Noble Arms' monster (Celtic Guard of Noble Arms).
allow.Noble Arms - Excaliburn: Equip Spell searchable by Heritage of the Chalice that makes Celtic Guard of Noble Arms untargetable and fuels Morgan.
allow.Noble Arms of Destiny: Equip Spell that protects a Celtic Guard from being destroyed by battle or card effect once per turn.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior that boosts all Warriors by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior upon destruction.
allow.Heroic Champion - Excalibur: Rank 4 EARTH Warrior Xyz that doubles its ATK to 4000 to clear high-ATK threats.
allow.Blade Armor Ninja: Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that allows a Celtic Guard to attack twice per Battle Phase to double Noble Arms' draw trigger.

main: Celtic Guard of Noble Arms
Once per turn Special Summons a Celtic Guard from hand, attacks when your hand is empty, and draws cards equal to the Celtic Guards you control when inflicting battle damage.
Obnoxious Celtic Guard
Cannot be destroyed by battle with any monster that has 1900 or more ATK, serving as an unbreakable wall and extra Celtic Guard name for Noble Arms' draw effect.
Celtic Guardian
Classic Level 4 EARTH Warrior Normal Monster summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai to boost Noble Arms' draw count.
Morgan, the Enchantress of Avalon
Quick Effect handtrap that negates an opponent's card activation while you control Celtic Guard of Noble Arms.
Heritage of the Chalice
Searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms (which is always treated as a 'Noble Arms' card) from the Deck or GY.
Unexpected Dai
Summons Celtic Guardian from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Celtic Guard of Noble Arms or Obnoxious Celtic Guard.
Triggered Summon
Signature Trap that lets both players Special Summon a Level 4 or lower monster from their hand when an opponent Special Summons.
Noble Arms - Excaliburn
Equip Spell searchable by Heritage of the Chalice that makes Celtic Guard of Noble Arms untargetable and fuels Morgan.
Noble Arms of Destiny
Equip Spell that protects a Celtic Guard from being destroyed by battle or card effect once per turn.
extra: Link-2 Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and floats upon destruction.
Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that detaches 2 materials to reach 4000 ATK.
Rank 4 Warrior Xyz that grants Celtic Guard of Noble Arms a second attack, letting it draw up to 6 cards in one Battle Phase.
